Nibble is MIT licensed (see LICENSE). Third-party work that ships inside it keeps its
own terms, and every one of those licences travels with the build:

  * Icon path data - Lucide (ISC) and Simple Icons (CC0). See Icons-LICENSE.txt.

  * Silkscreen typeface, by Jason Kottke - SIL Open Font License 1.1.
    See Silkscreen-OFL.txt.

  * Monocraft typeface, by Idrees Hassan (used by the Minecraft-style theme) -
    SIL Open Font License 1.1. See Monocraft-OFL.txt.

  * The Minecraft-style theme's block textures are generated by tools/Textures in
    this repository - no Mojang art, no third-party pixel art.

The rendering engine is not bundled and is not Nibble's: Nibble drives the Microsoft
Edge WebView2 Runtime that Windows already provides, under Microsoft's terms, and
Microsoft Edge Update keeps it current.
